summary: A light footer on a flat #f3f3f3 page. Four text columns start at y≈394: "product", "resources", "connect" and "disclaimer", with left edges at x≈291, 696, 1101 and 1505 (a 405 px pitch). Headings are near-black and links are mid-grey, in a ~22 px sans with a 52 px row pitch. Under the columns, the lowercase pixel wordmark "heyclicky" spans x 289–1867, y 664–969. Every pixel of it is a small light-blue macOS folder icon, about 56×46 px, each with a darker tab at its top left. A macOS trash can sits at the far left (x≈81) and one larger blue folder at the far right (x≈1910); both are vertically level with the wordmark's top row. "© Humansongs, Inc. 2026" is small grey type centred at the bottom (y≈1042). A soft grey blurred shadow hangs off the top edge at the centre. Motion has two parts. (1) Hover, from 0 to 4.5 s and again from 6.4 to 8.5 s: as the cursor passes over the wordmark, the folders under and near it open. Each front panel tilts forward and a white paper sheet shows above it. They close again within about 0.2 s once the cursor leaves. At 2.3 s the whole first "l" stack is open; at 7.5 s the folders of "e" and the top of "y" are open. (2) Clicking the big right-hand folder at about 4.6 s opens a macOS QuickTime-style window titled "yc-demoday.mov". The window grows from a smaller box on the right (≈926,219,764,461 at 4.67 s) to its full size, centred at 582,62,994,600, by 5.08 s. Its video area fades from translucent white through dark grey to black. Meanwhile the page behind dims to mid-grey and blurs. Around 6.2–6.35 s the window fades out and the backdrop clears back to #f3f3f3, with no blur.

criteria.check: Page background is flat light grey ≈#f3f3f3 with no gradient
Exactly 4 text columns sit above the wordmark
Column left edges at x≈291, 696, 1101 and 1505 (±10px), all headings on one baseline at y≈394
Headings read exactly 'product', 'resources', 'connect', 'disclaimer', all lowercase
Headings are near-black, clearly darker than the grey links beneath them
Product column lists 'features', 'pricing', 'changelog', 'try it' in that order
Resources column lists 'trust', 'privacy', 'referrals', 'support'
Connect column lists 'instagram', 'x (twitter)', 'linkedin', 'youtube'
Link rows are ≈52px apart, centred at y≈446, 497, 549, 601
Disclaimer reads '*heyclicky only sees your screen / when you press the hotkey - / screenshots are never stored*' on 3 lines
Link and disclaimer text is mid-grey (≈#555–#666), regular weight, ~22px sans
A lowercase wordmark 'heyclicky' (9 letters) spans under the columns
Wordmark runs from x≈289 to x≈1867, top y≈664, baseline y≈905, descenders of both y's down to y≈969
Each letter pixel is a small macOS-style folder icon, not a flat square or a brick
Folder body is light sky blue ≈#6dcff6, with a darker blue tab at the top-left and a lighter top edge
Folder tiles are ≈56×46px; the i-dot is one tile at ≈(1208,666) with a visible gap above the i stem
Folders overlap slightly and carry a soft bottom shadow, with no dark outline strokes
Letter strokes are one folder wide; the 'l' and 'k' are tall columns about 5 folders high above the baseline
A macOS-style silver trash can with colourful papers poking out sits at the far left, ≈(81,682,81,97)
The trash reads as metallic grey with a vertical sheen, not a flat grey shape
A larger blue folder ≈99×81px sits at the far right, ≈(1910,658), level with the wordmark top
Bottom line reads '© Humansongs, Inc. 2026' in small grey type, centred at x≈1079, y≈1042
A soft blurred grey shadow hangs from the top edge around x 940–1230
Folders under the cursor open: the front panel tilts forward (wider at top) and a white paper sheet shows above it
The revealed papers are white to pale grey, sitting behind the tilted front, not a blue outline
At 2.3s the whole first 'l' stack is open; by 2.8s it has closed and folders further along the word are open instead
At 7.5s folders in the 'e' and the top of the first 'y' (x≈520–790) are open, while the 'l' stack is closed
Folder positions do not shift between rest frames: opening a folder tilts it in place, and the wordmark outline stays fixed
Text columns and copyright stay still across the hover period
After the big folder is clicked (~4.6s) the whole page dims to mid-grey
With the window open, the page behind is blurred (link text unreadable), not just darkened
A macOS window titled 'yc-demoday.mov' is open at the centre-top
Window spans ≈x 582–1576, y 62–662, centred horizontally on the frame
The light-grey title bar is ≈42px tall, with rounded top corners and a soft drop shadow round the window
Three dots at the top-left of the title bar, red, yellow and green from left to right
Title text reads 'yc-demoday.mov' in grey, centred in the title bar
Video area is solid black, filling the window below the title bar with a thin light border
Video shows 'HeyClicky' in large white type with 'Farza Majeed' beneath it, 'Majeed' in orange-red
Right-side inset ≈279×209px at (1284,274) shows a speaker photo on a pale blue background (the clip's footage or a same-size placeholder in those colours)
A white speaker/volume icon sits at the video's bottom-right, ≈(1527,615)
The window grows out from the right: at 4.67s it is a smaller translucent white box ≈(926,219,764,461) and reaches full size at (582,62) by 5.08s
While opening, the window is semi-transparent: the page text shows faintly through it
Video area darkens from dark grey at 5.08s to solid black by 5.7s
The window fades out between ~6.2s and 6.35s; at 6.28s it is only a faint ghost and the page is readable again
By 7.5s the backdrop is fully gone: the page is back to #f3f3f3 with no blur and no window
Cursor becomes a pointing hand while over the big right folder
The dim is an even grey wash over the whole frame, with no vignette and no coloured tint
Under the dim, the wordmark folders read as muted steel-blue, darker than at rest
